cohort.name: Stephen Curry
cohort.explicit_assessment: Elite off-ball shooting/gravity and demonstrated offensive engine; age and availability are counterweights.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Strong catch/movement/pull-up capability is a reasonable context-specific implication, not three independent measured samples. No timed release or distance-extension mechanics measured.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Desmond Bane
cohort.explicit_assessment: Elite movement/spot-up/pull-up shooting, physical straight-line drives/touch; pressure/switching, inside finishing and separation limit primary offense.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Useful shooting in several modes need not imply paint access. Limited creation may change opportunities without changing shooting execution.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Devin Vassell
cohort.explicit_assessment: One view credits difficult catch/movement/pull-up shooting; counterview calls him solid and jump-shot-dependent. User-confirmed Devin Vel identity.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Keep overlapping but uncertain mode estimates, not unanimous elite ability. No new identity inference or rank conversion.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Derrick White
cohort.explicit_assessment: Rough2025–26 shooting and limited inside scoring/creation; rebound expectation is a forecast; connective offense remains useful.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Moderate credible catch-shoot profile may coexist with high volume and poor current efficiency. Exact release/preparation time not established.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Luka Dončić
cohort.explicit_assessment: Elite on-ball shot-making/P&R/isolation and passing; longer average shot distance/settling, reduced rim access and health context.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Strong live-dribble shooting is a reasonable implication. Jump-shot skill, shot appetite and paint access must remain separate; no midrange-specific grade inferred from all jumpers.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Darius Garland
cohort.explicit_assessment: On/off-ball shooting, P&R and floater praised; small-guard finishing/FT limitations and repeated health concerns; late Clippers improvement.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Floater conversion does not supply rim access. Healthy technique hypothesis and mixed injury/role season remain distinct.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Zion Williamson
cohort.explicit_assessment: Exceptional rim pressure, power/first step, touch, ball control, cutting/rolling and finishing; major availability concern.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Close-touch/contact control likely contributes, but power/strength/jump and drive craft cannot be credited twice as pure finishing technique. Low three volume does not independently identify latent shooting skill.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Dylan Harper
cohort.explicit_assessment: Size, pace, body control, varied paint finishing and confidence; shooting/advanced reads need development; superstar language is projection.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Support present close-control and broad contact-technique hypotheses, not automatic range/release growth. No earlier NBA season is expected.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Rudy Gobert
cohort.explicit_assessment: Elite defense with severe scoring/playoff offensive limitations; improved involvement with a creator is discussed.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Nonspacing/roll-target threat is an effective opportunity/context contrast. Low three attempts and assisted finishes do not measure all shooting/catch/lob techniques or self-creation.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Ivica Zubac
cohort.explicit_assessment: Dependable paint finishing, touch, screens/post punishment and rebounding; Indiana pace/creator fit requires adjustment.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Close touch can support a broad estimate; specific post hooks use S23 later, not a second S10 bonus. Roll/catch windows depend on supply and timing.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Bam Adebayo
cohort.explicit_assessment: Versatile defense and playmaking; inefficient jump-shot-heavy diet, cited41% two-point jumpers/below32% threes; role beside Giannis projected.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Shooting willingness and conversion differ; all-jumper evidence cannot independently split catch/pull-up midrange. No automatic raw technique grades for those splits.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking

cohort.name: Victor Wembanyama
cohort.explicit_assessment: Strong overall offense/gravity with paint polish/Finals finishing limitations and growth forecasts; extraordinary tools.
cohort.inference_and_limits: Size/reach does not guarantee close-touch technique. Stretch/mobility threat and healthy current finishing are distinct from forecasts and lob opportunity.
cohort.actor_identity: unidentified/local turns, no persistent speaker tracking
